question:
Assertion (A): In an optical fiber, the refractive index of the core ($n_1$) is kept higher than the refractive index of the cladding ($n_2$).
Reason (R): Total internal reflection occurs only when light travels from a denser medium to a rarer medium.

options.A: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.B: Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
options.C: A is true but R is false.
options.D: A is false but R is true.
